title: Centrifugal pump envelope dimensions: ISO 2858 (EN ISO 2858) and ASME B73.1, API 610 type list
note: ISO 2858:1975 and ASME B73.1 are paywalled. Rows are transcribed from freely published manufacturer catalogues as quoted by search extracts; a row is grade A only when two independent catalogues give the same numbers. The standards themselves were not read.

iso2858.designation: DNs-DNd-impeller nominal diameter, mm (e.g. 65-40-250: 65 mm suction, 40 mm discharge, 250 mm impeller) [S19]
iso2858.scope: end-suction centrifugal pumps, rating 16 bar, flange sizes 50..200 mm [S19]

dimensionMeaning.a: suction flange face to the centre of the discharge nozzle, along the shaft (mm)
dimensionMeaning.f: discharge nozzle centre to the free end of the bearing frame along the shaft (mm)
dimensionMeaning.h1: shaft centre height above the pump foot plane (mm)
dimensionMeaning.h2: discharge flange face height above the shaft centre (mm)
dimensionMeaning.remark: meaning of a/f taken from catalogue drawings (S20, S21); confirm against the standard (open question Q4)

sources: S21 Standard Pumps SEL / Apec Milano

asmeB73_1.designation: dimension designation letters AA..A120; pumps with the same designation are dimensionally interchangeable (mounting, nozzle size and location, shaft, baseplate, foundation bolts) [S24, S25]

dimensionMeaning.D: shaft centre height above the foot plane (in)
dimensionMeaning.X: discharge flange face height above the shaft centre (in)

sources: S24 BaseTek dimension sheet (from ASME B73.1M-1991)

rows.text: horizontal, foot mounted, single stage, overhung, end suction, flexibly coupled on a baseplate
horizontal, centreline mounted, single bearing housing, flexibly coupled
vertical in-line, single stage, separate bearing bracket
radially split, one or two stage, between bearings
vertically suspended, wet pit, diffuser, single casing

sources: S26 wermac, hardhatengineer, whatispiping, powerzone extracts
api610Types.conflicts: VS2, VS6 and OH4/OH5 are described differently by different sources; not used

use: MVP: envelope + nozzle positions of add_pump are generated from the grade-A rows only; any other size needs explicit dimensions (or a user-supplied catalogue record) and is flagged unverified (AF-32). Weights and motor frames are not tabulated here (TBD - from the vendor datasheet).
